title: Video by earn.edits
description:
⏳ They didn’t invent aging. They invented the fear of it.

🎬 This documentary-style motion piece breaks down the business built around that fear — for decades, the beauty industry has sold wrinkles and fine lines as problems to fix. Creams, serums, treatments, procedures — all improving skin, none stopping time

🎞️ Built with cinematic imagery and editorial contrast — polished beauty shots against darker compositions, exposing the gap between idealized youth and the reality of getting older

💭 Skincare can improve your skin. It can’t stop time
